title: Task soft-prompt bank compressed through a shared Mirror codebook
dataset: WikiText-2 raw training articles; within-article token suffix held out for development
hypothesis: Eight independently learned task/article soft prompts can be represented by one shared rank-4 prompt basis plus per-task coordinates, preserving held-out continuation NLL while reducing serialized prompt-bank bytes.
physical_object: Eight Pythia-70M virtual input prompts, each 8 x 512 FP16 values, adapted to distinct WikiText articles
mirror_coordinate: Per-task rank-4 coordinates over a shared PCA basis of flattened soft-prompt vectors
task_construction: Each task is a distinct WikiText train article with >=2048 tokens. Prompt tuning uses article tokens 0:1024; held-out evaluation uses four 64-token contexts and 64-token targets sampled from suffix tokens 1024:2048.
controls: eight independent full-precision-trained and FP16-serialized soft prompts
exact native shared rank-4 PCA/low-rank code control

training.optimizer: AdamW on prompt embeddings only; Pythia weights frozen
training.initialization: embedding-scale Gaussian with std 0.02; independent seeds

compression.shared_basis: centered PCA across eight trained task prompts; retain rank 4
compression.serialization: FP16 shared mean, basis and per-task codes; evaluate after serialization round trip

evaluation.heldout_articles: same eight articles, token suffix disjoint from prompt fitting
evaluation.metric: mean next-token NLL over target tokens; include zero-prompt and full independent prompt

development.selection_metric: held-out NLL, actual serialized prompt-bank bytes, prompt reconstruction MSE, prompt reconstruction seconds, inference seconds and added virtual-token operations

storage.authority: actual serialized NPZ inference payload bytes
paid_objects: all independent prompt tensors or shared mean/basis/codes

success_gate: Both dev seeds: compressed prompt NLL delta <=0.05 nat/token versus full independent prompts, >=0.02 nat/token improvement versus zero prompt, serialized shared bank <=0.75x independent prompt bytes, and no exact native low-rank alias.
failure_gate: Any quality/byte miss or exact native low-rank representation alias.
boundaries: This is an eight-article task-bank screen, not broad task generalization
Held-out suffixes share article identity but not token positions with prompt fitting
Eight virtual input tokens are charged as runtime/context overhead for all prompt methods
Fresh data remain sealed after a dev quality miss or native alias
